restoration_recipe.cold_route: Use bridge.dispatch(record.bridge_request), which selects solve_modes then make_system and constructs one cold stationary loaded equilibrium. Never call make_system for this construction-only preflight.
restoration_recipe.saved_base: Take result.base.equilibrium_state from an actually computed modal result; check identity beam_interpolation, structural_operator, quiescent_density, model hash, node/element/constraint and mesh_recipe fields. This preflight has no accepted saved base.
restoration_recipe.fresh_network: Reparse exact original source with drela-segspl-v1; choose the same SourceDynamicNetwork or SourceQuiescentNetwork; pass same panels, condition=None, gravity=[0,0,-9.81], loads=[], and density1.23 only for still air. Set mesh_recipe=warm_start_recipe(model,panels,saved).
restoration_recipe.decode: x=restore(fresh_network,saved). This decodes and validates identity without solving. Recheck nfev=0 immediately after restore.
restoration_recipe.later_fresh_residual: Only when executing the worker: z=zeros_like(n.rj); evaluate n.residual(x,detail=True,elastic_motion=(z,z,z,z),circulation_rate=zeros(n.circulation_basis.panels)). Explicit body gravity is already attached to n; do not add a second gravity rotation. Compare to the saved physical base and balance gates.
restoration_recipe.dynamic_base: DynamicSystem(n,x,frame=fixed,position=[0,0,0],attitude=[0,0,0],velocity=[0,0,0],gravity_magnitude=9.81) supplies the checked fixed layout after the fresh residual passes. make_system(initial_state=...) performs correction and is not a no-solve residual replay.
restoration_recipe.limitations: The jig capture/restore tested here proves construction/serialization layout only. Neither equilibrium convergence nor descriptor/eigenvalue correctness was evaluated.
